---
title: "After the day"
---
A single day has room for the exercise and very little else. The [companion curriculum](../../companion/index.qmd) covers the material that the day can only mention in passing, in modules that each stand on their own, so take the one you need and leave the rest. The section "Going further" at the end of the report in the downloadable workspace holds four more exercises, for anyone who installs it: a sweep of a whole decision, the five analysts placed on the curve, the randomisation test beside the test of the model, and the replication with new data.

| If you want | Read |
|---|---|
| The ideas behind what you just did, and the arguments now being made against them | [The multiverse and its critics](../../companion/multiverse.qmd) |
| The design of the experiment: random assignment, names as treatments, comparisons among replies, randomisation inference, power and the ethics of deception | [Audit experiments](../../companion/experiments.qmd) |
| Every model on the menu, from a difference in proportions to the logit, and how to read odds ratios against percentage points | [Binary outcomes](../../companion/binary-outcomes.qmd) |
| The graph work at a slower pace, and a graph for a question of your own | [Causal graphs and conditioning](../../companion/dags.qmd) |
| R from the beginning, on the same data | [Getting started with R](../../companion/intro-r.qmd) |
| The document format in which your report is written | [Quarto and reproducible documents](../../companion/quarto.qmd) |
| To archive and version the report that you wrote | [Reproducibility repositories](../../companion/repositories.qmd), then [Git and GitHub](../../companion/git-github.qmd) |
| The replication with new data, in its own words and on its own data | The final report at [osf.io/2ug8x](https://osf.io/2ug8x/), and the de-identified data, the do-file and a dictionary at [osf.io/xseqg](https://osf.io/xseqg/) |
| The whole story of the case, with the sources | [The case study](../../cases/housing/index.qmd) and the [resources page](../../resources.qmd) |

The [short session](../housing-short/index.qmd) covers the same case in two to three hours, and is the format to suggest to a colleague who cannot give it a whole day. The one-day courses on [open science](../housing-one-day-open-science/index.qmd) and on [data tools](../housing-one-day-data-tools/index.qmd) take the same case with another focus: the first goes further into reproduction, replication and preregistration, the second into R, data management and reports.
